recap.text: Crawler Katia has a sponsor named Princess Formidable of the Skull Empire. Over pho, Carl concludes she is the sister of Prince Stalwart. Formidable opens a benefactor box containing one crossbow bolt that does nothing unless it lands in a deity's eye. Carl decides the sister is not a fan of her brother.

Princess Formidable sends a silver emergency benefactor box containing ten bolts of Petrify Rock Class. Mordecai says the box cost the princess a sizeable chunk of her net worth. Katia puts a bolt into the head of Maggie My, who stands over Carl with a celestial grenade. Katia reads the ledger and notes that her sister spends a lot of money to stop Carl.

Princess Formidable sends a scroll of worship to Crawler Katia in an emergency box, making Katia a worshipper of Eileithyia. Carl observes that Formidable does not get along with her family and is not in the dungeon on the ninth floor. From her cruiser in orbit, Formidable demands the Syndicate Council blow the star to stop the AI. The mantid representative proposes a decorum sanction, and Formidable is muted.

Princess Formidable takes a cruiser and tells the Syndicate she will trip a failsafe by hand. The AI pulls her off her ship and places her upside down in Orren's office. She chooses to teleport to Earth's surface. Her crew triggers the failsafe, which switches off the tunnel node in the Aryl system. If a yacht carrying the children of Stalwart is destroyed, the Skull Empire falls to Formidable.

beats.headline: A princess on the notice
beats.text: For the record: Crawler Katia has a sponsor, and the notice reads, in full, Princess Formidable of the Skull Empire. That is all it reads. Over pho, Crawler Carl works the rest out from something Zev told him: if Prince Stalwart was disowned for his failed attempt on Carl, the sister would be next in line. He assumes this is the sister. Crawler Hekla, it is noted in the same conversation, has drawn some interstellar ranch.
beats.gist: Princess Formidable of the Skull Empire sponsors Crawler Katia.

beats.headline: One bolt, for a brother
beats.text: Subject's first benefactor box is opened by a group that knows nothing about her except that she exists: youngest sister of Prince Maestro and Crown Prince Stalwart, two princes who want Crawler Carl dead. Inside is a single crossbow bolt, one of a hundred, which does nothing special unless it lands in a deity's eye. Crawler Carl reads the description and draws his conclusion aloud: the sister is not a huge fan of her big brother.
beats.gist: Princess Formidable is a royal and a sponsor.

beats.headline: Ten bolts, emergency rate
beats.text: An emergency benefactor box, silver, from subject. Mordecai says it must be opened at once, and that it probably cost the princess a sizeable chunk of her net worth. It holds ten bolts of Petrify Rock Class. Then Crawler Katia puts the first of them into the head of Maggie My, who has been riding inside another crawler and is standing over Crawler Carl with a celestial grenade in her hand. Crawler Katia's reading of the ledger: his sister is spending a lot of money to stop him.
beats.gist: Princess Formidable sends Katia a silver emergency benefactor box containing ten Petrify Rock Class bolts.

beats.headline: A scroll of worship, by emergency
beats.text: Another emergency box from subject to Crawler Katia, and this one holds a scroll of worship. Emergency boxes are opened immediately, so Crawler Katia reads it immediately, and becomes a worshipper of Eileithyia before she sees the goddess is sponsored by Huanxin Jinx. Crawler Carl files two observations. The princess apparently does not get along with the rest of her family. And she is still sending boxes, so she is not in the dungeon on the ninth floor with them.

beats.headline: Muted for proposing the failsafe
beats.text: Emergency session of the Syndicate Council. Subject, on the line from the cockpit of her cruiser in orbit, demands the failsafe: blow the star and wipe the system off the map before the AI infects the center system. Accused of wanting her father and brothers dead, she points out that she is in orbit and would die too. She would love her family deposed, she says, but this is bigger than that. The mantid representative proposes a decorum sanction. It passes at 86 percent, and she is muted.
beats.gist: Princess Formidable demands the Syndicate Council blow the star to stop the AI, so she is muted.

beats.headline: Her father's warship
beats.text: Reported by King Rust himself, under parlay. Subject and a detachment of Skull Empire marines have taken one of his cruisers, and it is about five hours from the monitor station orbiting Venus. She has told the entire Syndicate she means to go in and trip the failsafe by hand. She has told them the rest as well: the Skull Empire manufactures the satellites and builds back doors into everything it sells. Rust asks Crawler Carl to plead with her, on behalf of the people of Earth, to stop.
beats.gist: Princess Formidable takes a cruiser and moves toward the Venus monitor station to trip the failsafe.

beats.headline: Level 1, in a very small room
beats.text: Subject arrives in Orren's office upside down, three feet off the floor, in her space suit, and raises an arm weapon at the liaison. The AI, wearing Growler Gary, has pulled her off her own ship. Her info box reads Level 1, Orc: her father is dead, Stalwart is king, and six of his children stand ahead of her now. She learns the failsafe is already disabled. Offered death, the Scolopendra Club, a cabaret's backstage or Earth's surface, she chooses the surface, and teleports away with a crack.
beats.gist: Princess Formidable arrives upside down in Orren's office and raises an arm weapon at the liaison.

beats.headline: The crew presses the button
beats.text: Zev has the news a few hours old. Subject's ship went on to the station without her and stopped there. When the princess did not return, a few orcs went in and triggered the failsafe themselves. Nothing happened in this system. But at the exact moment they pressed it, the Aryl system, where the previous crawl was held, went dark, and its tunnel node switched off. Zev says that has never happened before in history.
beats.gist: Zev reports orcs triggered a failsafe that switched off the Aryl system tunnel node.

beats.headline: Next in line, if the yacht goes
beats.text: Succession, by Rosetta Thagra's arithmetic. Stalwart is dead, which makes one of his children king, and those children are aboard a yacht Rosetta's side has agreed to destroy in exchange for a pin number. If that is done, the Skull Empire falls to subject, provided she is still alive somewhere on Earth's surface. If she is not, it goes to the Maestro, disowned or not. Rosetta feels ill about the children.
beats.gist: Princess Formidable is next in line for the Skull Empire if Rosetta Thagra destroys a yacht.
